시편 54:1.content: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us? Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

시편 54:2.content: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

시편 54:3.content: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

시편 54:4.content: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

시편 54:5.content: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

시편 54:6.content: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

시편 54:7.content: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
